entities.name: Meren
entities.description: Human necromancer from Jund on Alara, exiled by her clan, who learned necromancy on Grixis and took vengeance.

entities.name: Kael
entities.description: Village elder and Meren's trainer and mentor, devoured by her dragon.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Meren learned necromancy.

events.summary: Meren is forced to drink the Dreamfire Draught and face an elemental; she destroys it using necromancy.
events.quote: destroyed the elemental using what she would eventually learn to be necromancy

events.summary: The elders deem her dangerous, let her fight the Draught, and she survives and leaves the clan for Grixis.
events.quote: Meren survived this, though, and left Clan Nel Toth

events.summary: Trained in Grixis, Meren reanimates a great dragon, Skaal Kesh.
events.quote: reanimated a great dragon she deemed Skaal Kesh

events.summary: Meren attacks her old home, killing most of its residents.
events.quote: she entered her old home and attacked it, killing most of the residents

events.summary: Meren duels Kael and the dragon devours him; she resolves to topple Jund.
events.quote: she gestured to the dragon, which then devoured the man

relations.quote: She was trained under a village elder known as Kael
Meren ( /mɛərən/, MAIR-en ) of Clan Nel Toth is a human necromancer
she gestured to the dragon, which then devoured the man
